scripts.sync:cards: rm -rf public/cards && mkdir -p public/cards && cp ../backend/src/main/resources/cards/*.jpg ../backend/src/main/resources/cards/*.webp public/cards/ 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.build: npm run sync:cards && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:to-backend: npm run sync:cards && tsc -b && vite build --outDir ../backend/src/main/resources/static/app --emptyOutDir
